a.lede: Google spooked investors so badly that its stock hit a six-month low, after it revealed its AI own search summaries were affecting ad revenue.
a.title: Google value plunges by $500bn as its own AI search hits ad sales

b.lede: Big tech stocks falter as investors question whether billions being poured into AI can generate returns quickly enough A sell-off of tech stocks that began earlier this month and gained steam with disappointing earnings from leading tech companies drove US markets down by hundreds of billions of dollars Friday. In total, the decline has knocked nearly $1tn in value off
b.title: Tech sell-off drives US markets down by nearly $1tn after subpar earnings reports
